title: Chuyên đề Câu đồng nghĩa
summary: Tổng hợp toàn diện các cấu trúc câu đồng nghĩa hay gặp và các bẫy đổi nghĩa tinh vi, giúp học sinh xử lý câu viết lại khó ở mức phân hóa điểm 9–10.

theory.heading: Đảo ngữ và nhấn mạnh
points: As soon as S + V2, S + V2 = No sooner had S + V3 than S + V2 = Hardly had S + V3 when S + V2
S + didn't + V + until … = Not until … did S + V = It was not until … that S + V2
Although S + be + adj = Adj + as/though + S + be (Rich as he is, …)

examples.en: As soon as she arrived home, she turned on the computer. → No sooner had she arrived home than she turned on the computer.
examples.vi: Cô ấy vừa về đến nhà là bật máy tính.

theory.heading: Câu ước, câu điều kiện, would rather
points: It's a pity/I'm sorry + S + can't/don't … = S + wish + S + could/V2 (ước ở hiện tại)
Sự thật quá khứ (… so …) → điều kiện loại 3 với nghĩa ngược: If + had (not) V3, S + would (not) have V3
prefer V-ing to V-ing = would rather V than V

examples.en: She didn't study hard, so she failed. → If she had studied hard, she wouldn't have failed.
examples.vi: Nếu cô ấy học chăm thì đã không trượt.

theory.heading: Bị động, tường thuật, động từ khuyết thiếu
points: Bị động tiếp diễn: are building → is being built; bị động kép: It is said that S + V = S + is said + to V
Câu mệnh lệnh phủ định "Don't …" → told sb not to V
It's not necessary for sb to V = sb don't have to / needn't V (khác mustn't = cấm)
S + stopped V-ing + time ago = S + haven't/hasn't V3 + for + time

examples.en: It is said that he is a talented painter. → He is said to be a talented painter.
examples.vi: Người ta nói anh ấy là một họa sĩ tài năng.

examples.en: It's not necessary for you to bring your laptop. → You don't have to bring your laptop.
examples.vi: Bạn không cần mang máy tính.

theory.heading: So sánh và các cấu trúc nguyên nhân – kết quả
points: the most + adj = No + N + is as adj as … = … + adj-er than any other + N số ít
so + adj + that = such + (a/an) + adj + N + that
S + couldn't V because of N = N + prevented S from V-ing

examples.en: The film was so boring that we left halfway. → It was such a boring film that we left halfway.
examples.vi: Bộ phim chán đến mức chúng tôi bỏ về giữa chừng.

tips: Bẫy phổ biến nhất: phương án đúng ngữ pháp nhưng đổi nghĩa (mustn't ≠ don't have to; As = vì ≠ Although).
Với câu điều kiện loại 3 từ sự thật quá khứ: đổi khẳng định ↔ phủ định ở CẢ hai vế.
Đảo ngữ: kiểm tra đủ ba thứ – trợ động từ đúng thì, chủ ngữ sau trợ động từ, liên từ đúng cặp (No sooner … than, Hardly … when).
So sánh nhất ↔ so sánh hơn: phải có "any other + N số ít"; thiếu "other" là sai logic.

exercise_sets.title: Bài 1. Đảo ngữ, câu ước, câu điều kiện
exercise_sets.instructions: Choose the sentence (A, B, C or D) that is closest in meaning to the given sentence.

questions.question: As soon as she arrived home, she turned on the computer.

options.A: She had turned on the computer before she arrived home.
options.B: No sooner had she arrived home than she turned on the computer.
options.C: No sooner did she arrive home when she turned on the computer.
options.D: Hardly she had arrived home when she turned on the computer.

questions.explanation: No sooner + had + S + V3 + than … diễn tả hai hành động liên tiếp. "Hardly" thiếu đảo ngữ; "No sooner … when" sai cặp liên từ.

questions.question: I didn't know the answer until the teacher explained it.

options.A: Not until the teacher explained it I knew the answer.
options.B: Not until the teacher explained it did I know the answer.
options.C: Not until did the teacher explain it I knew the answer.
options.D: Not until the teacher had explained it did I not know the answer.

questions.explanation: Not until + mệnh đề thường + đảo ngữ ở mệnh đề chính: "did I know".

questions.question: It's a pity I can't speak French.

options.A: I wish I could speak French.
options.B: I wish I can speak French.
options.C: I wish I couldn't speak French.
options.D: I wished I could speak French.

questions.explanation: Ước trái với hiện tại: wish + could + V. "wished" chuyển sang thời điểm quá khứ nên lệch thời gian.

questions.question: She didn't study hard, so she failed the exam.

options.A: Unless she had studied hard, she wouldn't have failed the exam.
options.B: If she studied hard, she wouldn't fail the exam.
options.C: If she had studied hard, she wouldn't have failed the exam.
options.D: If she had studied hard, she would have failed the exam.

questions.explanation: Sự thật quá khứ → điều kiện loại 3, đổi nghĩa ngược ở cả hai vế: had studied … wouldn't have failed.

questions.question: Although he is very rich, he isn't happy.

options.B: Rich though is he, he isn't happy.
options.C: Rich as he is, he isn't happy.
options.D: As he is rich, he isn't happy.

questions.explanation: Adj + as + S + be = mặc dù. "As he is rich" lại mang nghĩa "vì", làm sai quan hệ nhượng bộ.

exercise_sets.title: Bài 2. Bị động, tường thuật, động từ khuyết thiếu
exercise_sets.instructions: Choose the sentence (A, B, C or D) that is closest in meaning to the given sentence.

questions.question: They are building a new hospital in my town.

options.A: A new hospital is building in my town.
options.B: A new hospital has been built in my town.
options.C: A new hospital is being built in my town.
options.D: A new hospital is built in my town.

questions.explanation: Hiện tại tiếp diễn bị động: is/are + being + V3.

questions.question: "Don't touch the broken wire," the electrician said to us.

options.A: The electrician asked us to touch the broken wire.
options.B: The electrician said us not to touch the broken wire.
options.C: The electrician told us not to touch the broken wire.
options.D: The electrician told us don't touch the broken wire.

questions.explanation: Mệnh lệnh phủ định → told sb not to V. "said" không đi trực tiếp với tân ngữ người.

questions.question: It's not necessary for you to bring your laptop tomorrow.

options.A: You must bring your laptop tomorrow.
options.B: You mustn't bring your laptop tomorrow.
options.C: You don't have to bring your laptop tomorrow.
options.D: You needn't to bring your laptop tomorrow.

questions.explanation: "not necessary" = don't have to (không cần). "mustn't" là cấm – đổi nghĩa; "needn't to" sai ngữ pháp.

questions.question: My father stopped smoking two years ago.

options.A: My father has smoked for two years.
options.B: My father didn't smoke two years ago.
options.C: My father stopped to smoke two years ago.
options.D: My father hasn't smoked for two years.

questions.explanation: stopped V-ing + time ago = haven't/hasn't + V3 + for + time. "stopped to smoke" nghĩa là dừng lại để hút thuốc.

questions.question: It is said that he is a talented painter.

options.A: He is said to be a talented painter.
options.B: He is said to have been a talented painter.
options.C: He is said being a talented painter.
options.D: He said to be a talented painter.

questions.explanation: Bị động kép, hai động từ cùng thì hiện tại → is said + to V. "to have been" chỉ dùng khi hành động xảy ra trước.

exercise_sets.title: Bài 3. So sánh và nguyên nhân – kết quả
exercise_sets.instructions: Choose the sentence (A, B, C or D) that is closest in meaning to the given sentence.

questions.question: Lan is the most intelligent student in her class.

options.A: Some students in her class are more intelligent than Lan.
options.B: Lan is as intelligent as the other students in her class.
options.C: Lan is more intelligent than any student in her class.
options.D: No student in her class is as intelligent as Lan.

questions.explanation: So sánh nhất = "No + N + as … as". "than any student" thiếu "other" nên sai logic (Lan cũng là một học sinh trong lớp).

questions.question: The film was so boring that we left halfway.

options.A: It was so a boring film that we left halfway.
options.B: The film was too boring for us to leave halfway.
options.C: It was such boring film that we left halfway.
options.D: It was such a boring film that we left halfway.

questions.explanation: so + adj + that = such + a + adj + N + that. "too … for us to leave" đảo ngược nghĩa.

questions.question: He prefers reading books to watching TV.

options.A: He prefers to watch TV than read books.
options.B: He would rather watch TV than read books.
options.C: He would rather read books than watch TV.
options.D: He would rather reading books than watching TV.

questions.explanation: prefer V-ing to V-ing = would rather + V + than + V; giữ đúng thứ tự ưu tiên (đọc sách > xem TV).

questions.question: We couldn't go out because of the heavy rain.

options.A: Despite the heavy rain, we couldn't go out.
options.B: The heavy rain made us go out.
options.C: The heavy rain prevented us from going out.
options.D: The heavy rain prevented us to go out.

questions.explanation: N + prevented + sb + from V-ing = vì N mà ai đó không thể làm gì. "Despite" đổi quan hệ nguyên nhân thành nhượng bộ.

questions.question: The last time I went swimming was in 2022.
questions.explanation: The last time … was + mốc = haven't + V3 + since + mốc.
